Package com.robojacks.lib.vision

Class GpsPoseEstimator

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.vision.GpsPoseEstimator
public class GpsPoseEstimator extends Object
Turns GPS readings into pose estimates for the drive's pose estimator: VEX's version of PhotonVision's PhotonPoseEstimator. It drops readings the GPS isn't sure of, rate-limits repeats, corrects for latency, and says how much to trust each estimate. 

 private final VexGps m_gps = new VexGps(kGpsPort, kGpsLeftOffset, kGpsForwardOffset);
 private final GpsPoseEstimator m_estimator = new GpsPoseEstimator(m_gps);

 public void periodic() {
     m_estimator.update().ifPresent(est ->
             m_consumer.accept(est.estimatedPose, est.timestampSeconds, m_estimator.getEstimationStdDevs()));
 }

Like PhotonVision, the standard deviations grow with the reading's uncertainty: the GPS's reported error plays the part of tag distance and ambiguity.
